title: Revamped MFTF
description: This is a texture pack for the infamous Man From the Fog by M-Productions, but it makes him scarier.
body: This is a terrifying texture pack for the infamous Man from the Fog, making it scarier, and more importantly, more accurate to my upcoming series: The Anomalies. Have fun my little hard shelled hamburgers, and good luck (You'll need it).
